description: Removes a planned maintenance entry from a status page with all its updates. Irreversible. If a maintenance is just cancelled, publishing a "cancelled" timeline update is usually preferable — otherwise users will not see the history.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_maintenance_delete
title: Delete planned maintenance from status page
